game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Festival Grounds, the festival grounds: the herald must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before siege rats can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Festival Grounds: the festival grounds
core_gameplay_loop: In Festival Grounds, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before siege rats can use it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about wave_target to power up the herald and open the throne.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Festival Grounds'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Festival Grounds.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
